Renamed to red_m_mm for inclusion in ; crispred pipeline. ; FUNCTION red_m_mm, sc, pbs=pbs ; return modulation matrix for a LC scheme ; scheme should be array [2,n] IF NOT keyword_set(pbs) THEN pbs = 0 s = size(sc, /dim) ns = s(1) res = fltarr(4, ns) FOR i=0, ns-1 DO res(*, i) = $ (2*m_pbs(pbs)##red_m_retard(sc(1, i),45.,/deg)##red_m_retard(sc(0, i),0.,/deg))(*,0) return, res END
